sec.title: August 27 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 236)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 27** across American network radio and the BBC, live CBS war reporting on the Liberation of Paris, A.J. Alan's Dartmoor mystery on the BBC, Lucille Ball & Richard Denning in *My Favorite Husband* for Jell-O, space opera thrills on *Captain Starr of Space*, Ronald Reagan pitching in *Stars Over Hollywood* for Dial Soap, and Ruth Cornwall Woodman's desert mystery *Death Valley Sheriff* for 20 Mule Team Borax (1944–1975):
